definitions.explanation: The quality of exercising self-control and behaving within appropriate limits. Implies knowing where to draw the line in behavior, consumption, or expression.

examples.japanese: {節度|せつど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がける→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: I try to act with moderation.

notes:
USAGE:
{節度|せつど} conveys a sense of measured, appropriate behavior. It is frequently paired with ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (having moderation) or ⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (maintaining moderation). The word carries a positive connotation of maturity and self-discipline.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {節度|せつど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: moderate, restrained
- {節度|せつど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to maintain moderation
- {節度|せつど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have restraint
- {節度|せつど}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: a restrained attitude
- {節度|せつど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{欠|か}く→欠く：13166_kaku⟧: to lack moderation
